%%COMMON%%

Test Data Check

Drop in a file of minerals you've panned and it works out the real drop rates, modifier split and weights, then compares them with what the toolkit expects.
Nothing leaves your device: the file is read right here in your browser.

Heads up: this only tells you something when the file is big. A few hundred rows will look wrong by chance; a few thousand per mineral is where the drop rates settle down. Rarities you barely saw are marked as thin data.

1 · Your file

or drop it here, or paste below

2 · Which column is what

Only Mineral is needed. Add Zone to check drop rates, Modifier for the modifier split, and Weight plus Size Boost for weights. Luck, Modifier Boost and Capacity let it compare against the toolkit's own numbers.

3 · What it found

How to read it

  • Drop rates: how often each mineral actually came up in a zone, next to the chance the toolkit lists for it. The ratio is what matters: 1.00× means the toolkit agrees with your file. Anything well away from 1 with plenty of rows behind it is worth a look, since it usually means the game changed.
  • Modifiers: the share of minerals that got one, and which ones. The toolkit's own model is worked out at the Modifier Boost and luck in your file, so the two columns should line up.
  • Weights: every weight divided by that mineral's base weight, so all minerals can be compared on one scale.
  • Thin data marks anything with too few rows to trust. Treat those lines as a hint, not a finding.
